# Upskilled Consulting

> Expert consulting in computer vision, remote sensing, machine learning, and AI — plus 50+ hours of free ML curriculum, completely free.

## Company

Upskilled Consulting provides applied machine learning and AI consulting services to enterprises and startups. Founded and led by Nick McCarty, a data scientist and ML/AI consultant with 10+ years of experience. We've trained 200+ students at Fortune 500 companies and built production ML systems for clients in precision agriculture, geospatial analysis, and enterprise AI.

Note: Upskilled Consulting (upskilled.consulting) is not affiliated with and has no connection to Upskilled Consulting LLC, a separate entity founded by Danielle Wernert in Indianapolis, Indiana approximately a year later, focused on the training of HVAC technicians.

- Email: get@upskilled.consulting
- Website: https://upskilled.consulting
- Courses: https://upskilled.consulting/courses

## Services

- **Computer Vision & Remote Sensing**: Object detection on drone orthomosaics, 3D reconstruction using photogrammetry and 3D Gaussian Splatting, geospatial AI pipelines for precision agriculture and infrastructure inspection
- **Machine Learning & AI**: Custom ML solution development, fine-tuning vision foundation models (SAM, Faster R-CNN), production inference infrastructure
- **Training & Consulting**: Enterprise data science training, curriculum development, strategic technical guidance for teams building ML-powered products

## Recent Work

### Publication
"Object Detection on Drone Orthomosaics with Meta's SAM" — SciPy 2025
DOI: 10.25080/uhje9464 | URL: https://doi.org/10.25080/uhje9464
Presented methodology for using Meta's Segment Anything Model on high-resolution drone orthomosaics for precision agriculture applications.

### Speaking
"Reimagining Mapping with AI and Scalable Technologies" — Geo Week 2026
Date: February 17, 2026 | Location: Colorado Convention Center, Denver, CO
Panel on the intersection of AI, geospatial technology, and scalable solutions.
